text: dsh-live-preview 是 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面的实时页面预览插件。它在会话旁提供可调整宽度的预览面板，可从已注册工作区选择 HTML 页面，并通过本地预览服务显示。文件保存后可自动刷新并定位改动区块，也可手动刷新或由 agent 工具打开页面。适合边开发边查看静态网页；无需 API Key。

dsh-live-preview adds a preview panel to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI. Choose a workspace HTML page to view beside the conversation. File changes reload it and focus the edited area. Refresh manually or use the agent tool to open a page. It helps developers iterate on static pages without an API key.
想在 DSH 聊天旁边直接看我正在做的网页。
保存 HTML 后能不能自动刷新页面预览？
I want to preview a workspace HTML page next to my DSH conversation.
dsh-live-preview 的功能「工作区页面预览」：在会话侧边打开可调整宽度的面板，从工作区浏览目录并选择 HTML 页面进行预览；也能通过 live_preview 工具指定页面。
dsh-live-preview 的功能「改动刷新与定位」：文件变更时可自动重载预览，并将页面滚动到对应源码行或 CSS 选择器；面板也提供手动刷新与聚焦操作。
dsh-live-preview 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 24 天；提交数 13；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

dsh-live-preview README · Live Preview for DeepSeek Harness：[中文说明](./README.zh-CN.md) · [Changelog](./CHANGELOG.md) · MIT

A DeepSeek Harness plugin that adds a **live-preview panel** to the Web UI. Pick a workspace, browse to an HTML
page, and it renders beside the conversation — every save reloads it. The agent can open pages too, through the
`live_preview` tool.

> Built for the "let me see what you are making" loop: chat on the left, your page on the right, no window
> switching.

dsh-live-preview README · Features：- Preview panel docked to the right of the Harness UI; drag its left edge to resize, width and device mode are remembered
- Workspace → directory → file browser with an `HTML` badge
- **Auto reload on save** (SSE, with a version-poll fallback), toggleable, plus a manual reload button.
  Only files the preview actually loaded trigger a reload, so unrelated workspace activity (service logs, data
  dumps) does not keep reloading your page.
- **Focus on what is being edited** — the preview scrolls to and outlines the block that just changed, and the panel
  shows an "Editing …" chip; automatic on save (HTML by source line, CSS by rule selector) and available through the tool
- Device widths: full / 768 px / 375 px, and open-in-new-tab
- **Survives a Harness restart** — the last open page is remembered in the browser and restored when the panel
  was open, so a restart no longer leaves it blank
- **Separate window** — open the preview in your system default browser and collapse the in-panel view, so the
  conversation gets its space back; live reload / focus keep working in that window
- Agent tool `live_preview` with `open` / `close` / `refresh` / `ro

dsh-live-preview README · Requirements：- DeepSeek Harness with the Web UI (the `dsh web` app or the desktop app)
- Node.js 20+ on the Harness host

dsh-live-preview README · Install：1. Clone this repository anywhere on the Harness host.
2. Install it as a local bundle — ask the Harness agent, or call the plugin manager directly:

```
   plugin_manager install_bundle(target: "/absolute/path/to/dsh-live-preview")
   ```

(In the UI: Plugins → Add → local bundle directory.)
3. **Refresh the Web UI** (Ctrl+R). An eye icon appears in the session header.

> A local-directory install links the checkout in place. If you move or delete the folder, reinstall the bundle.

dsh-live-preview README · Use：- **Eye icon** — open / close the preview panel
- **Workspace dropdown** — switch the preview root (registered workspaces only)
- **Choose file** — browse folders, click an HTML file to preview it, click a folder to enter
- **Full / Tablet / Phone** — preview width (phone = 375 px)
- **Auto reload** — whether file changes reload the page
- **Reload** — reload the current page manually
- **Open in a new tab** — hand the page to your system browser
- **Separate window** — open the preview in your default browser and close the panel, for when the panel feels
  too wide; auto reload and the edit highlight keep working there. (The desktop shell blocks `window.open`, so
  the Host opens it instead.)
- Drag the panel's left edge to resize it

dsh-live-preview README · Use：Ask the agent to open a page for you:

```
Open the live preview on maas-home-preview/index.html
```

The agent calls `live_preview({ action: "open", path: "maas-home-preview/index.html" })`.
dsh-live-preview README · Focus — show the block being edited：When a watched file changes, the plugin works out *where* the edit landed and tells the preview to point at it:
section: Focus — show the block being edited

dsh-live-preview README · Focus — show the block being edited：- **HTML** — served pages carry `data-lp-line` markers on elements. The change is diffed against the last served
  revision, and the element nearest the changed source line is scrolled into view and outlined.
- **CSS** — the selector of the rule surrounding the changed line is resolved and every matching element is outlined
  (up to 12).
- Other text files — the panel still shows "Editing … · line N" without a page outline.

dsh-live-preview README · Configuration：Edit the plugin row's `config` in your `cordis.patch.yml` patch layer:

```yaml
- id: dsh-live-preview
  config:
    port: 8123              # 0 = pick a free port; a busy port falls back automatically
    autoReload: true        # broadcast reloads by default

dsh-live-preview README · How it works：```
Harness Web UI (:59936, authenticated)
├── session header utilities  → eye toggle (client plugin)
├── shell.overlay             → preview panel (React, theme tokens)
│        │ fetch same-origin JSON API (/dsh-live-preview/*)

`live_preview` opens a page by resolving the path against the caller's session working directory, then picking
the nearest registered workspace as the preview root.

dsh-live-preview README · Security model：- The preview server binds `127.0.0.1` only
- Every file request needs the per-process random token (`?t=`) or the `dshprev` HttpOnly cookie
- Read-only: no write endpoint
- Each request is checked with `realpath` + containment; `..`, encoded traversal and symlink escapes are rejected
- The previewed page gets its own origin, so it cannot read the Harness UI's storage or authenticated API
- No LAN or remote access

dsh-live-preview README · Limitations：- Static files only; a project that needs `npm run dev` is not proxied (planned)
- Pages that call absolute-path backend endpoints will 404
- If the page's own CSP blocks the injected reload script, the panel-side fallback still reloads it — that fallback
  needs one page refresh after installing/updating
- The boot contract (`window.__ModuleLoader__`, slot APIs) is internal to Harness; a major Harness upgrade may need a
  small plugin update

dsh-live-preview README · Development：```powershell
git clone https://github.com/2011126630z-commits/dsh-live-preview
cd dsh-live-preview
npm test        # node:test — auth, traversal, MIME, injection (syntax-checked), SSE, port fallback, cleanup
```

dsh-live-preview README · DeepSeek Harness 实时预览插件：[English](./README.md) · [更新日志](./CHANGELOG.md) · MIT

一个给 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面加**实时预览面板**的插件。选一个工作区、点开一个 HTML 页面，它就会显示在对话旁边；
文件一保存就自动刷新。模型也可以通过 `live_preview` 工具主动打开页面。

> 专为「你做一版我看一版」这个循环做的：左边聊天，右边你的页面，不用来回切窗口。
section: DeepSeek Harness 实时预览插件

text:
dsh-live-preview README · 功能：- 面板浮在界面右侧，拖左边缘可调宽度；宽度与设备模式会记住
- 工作区 → 目录 → 文件浏览，HTML 文件带 `HTML` 标记
- **保存即自动刷新**（SSE 优先，断线降级为版本轮询），可开关，另有手动刷新。
  只有预览页真正加载过的文件变化才会触发重载，工作区里其它程序写日志/数据不会一直刷新你的页面。
- **高亮正在改的那一块**：预览页会自动滚到并描边刚改动的区块，面板顶部显示「正在编辑 …」；
  保存即自动触发（HTML 按源码行、CSS 按规则选择器），也能通过工具手动指定
- 全宽 / 768px / 375px 三种预览宽度，可外开浏览器
- **Harness 重启后自动恢复**：最后一个打开的页面记在浏览器里，重启后自动恢复（之前是打开状态才恢复），不再一片空白
- **独立窗口**：在系统默认浏览器里打开预览，并收起面板，把空间还给对话；自动刷新和高亮在窗口里照常工作
- Agent 工具 `live_preview`：`open` / `close` / `refresh` / `root` / `focus` / `clear`
- 预览服务只绑本机回环、只读、一次性 token + HttpOnly Cookie、realpath 包含性校验
- 被预览页面跑在独立 origin，与 Harness 界面隔离

dsh-live-preview README · 环境要求：- 带 Web 界面的 DeepSeek Harness（`dsh web` 或桌面版）
- Harness 所在机器上 Node.js 20+

dsh-live-preview README · 安装：1. 把仓库克隆到 Harness 所在机器的任意目录。
2. 作为本地 bundle 安装——让 Harness 里的 AI 执行，或直接调用插件管理器：

```
   plugin_manager install_bundle(target: "/绝对路径/dsh-live-preview")
   ```

（界面里：插件 → 添加 → 本地 bundle 目录。）
3. **刷新 Web 界面**（Ctrl+R），会话标题栏右侧会出现眼睛图标。

> 本地目录安装是链接式安装；移动或删除目录后需要重新安装。

dsh-live-preview README · 使用：- **眼睛图标**：开 / 关预览面板
- **工作区下拉**：切换预览根目录（只能选已注册的工作区）
- **选择文件**：逐层浏览目录，点 HTML 文件即预览，点目录进入
- **全宽 / 平板 / 手机**：切换预览宽度（手机 = 375px）
- **自动刷新**：文件变化时是否自动重载
- **刷新**：手动重载当前页
- **在新标签打开**：交给系统浏览器
- **独立窗口**：在系统默认浏览器里打开预览并收起面板；觉得面板太宽时用它，自动刷新与编辑高亮照常工作。
  （桌面版拦截 `window.open`，所以由 Host 端调用系统默认浏览器打开。）
- 拖面板左边缘可以调宽

让 AI 帮你打开页面：

```
打开实时预览，看一下 maas-home-preview/index.html
```

模型会调用 `live_preview({ action: "open", path: "maas-home-preview/index.html" })`。

dsh-live-preview README · 高亮「正在改的那一块」：监听到文件变化时，插件会判断这次改动落在哪里，并让预览页指过去：

- **HTML**：served 的页面元素上带有 `data-lp-line` 源码行标记；与上一次服务的版本做 diff，取改动行附近最近的
  区块，滚到视野内并描边。
- **CSS**：从改动行往前找所属规则的选择器，把所有匹配元素描边（最多 12 个）。
- 其他文本文件：面板照常显示「正在编辑 … · 第 N 行」，但页面上不描边。

高亮会跟着重载一起走（存在 `sessionStorage` 里），所以刷新之后仍会落在新页面上。也可以显式触发：

```jsonc
{ "action": "focus", "selector": "#hero" }
{ "action": "focus", "path": "index.html", "line": 312 }
{ "action": "clear" }
```

面板上会显示当前目标，并提供「定位」（重新高亮）和「×」（清除）；约 15 秒后自动淡出。

dsh-live-preview README · 配置：在 `cordis.patch.yml` 的 patch 层里改这一行插件的 `config`：

```yaml
- id: dsh-live-preview
  config:
    port: 8123              # 0 = 自动挑空闲端口；被占用会自动顺延
    autoReload: true        # 默认自动刷新

dsh-live-preview README · 工作原理：```
Harness Web 界面（:59936，带登录态）
├── 会话标题栏工具区 → 眼睛开关（客户端插件）
├── shell.overlay     → 预览面板（React + 主题 token）
│        │ 同源 JSON 接口（/dsh-live-preview/*）

`live_preview` 打开页面时，会先按调用方 Session 的工作目录解析路径，再取最近的已注册工作区作为预览根。

dsh-live-preview README · 安全边界：- 预览服务只监听 `127.0.0.1`
- 每个文件请求都要带上本进程随机 token（`?t=`）或 `dshprev` HttpOnly Cookie
- 只读：没有任何写接口
- 每个请求都做 `realpath` + 包含性校验，`..`、编码穿越、符号链接逃逸一律拒绝
- 预览页面使用独立 origin，读不到 Harness 界面的存储和登录态
- 不提供局域网 / 远程访问

dsh-live-preview README · 已知限制：- 只预览静态文件；需要 `npm run dev` 的项目暂不代理（计划中）
- 页面里如果把后端接口写成绝对路径会 404
- 若页面自身的 CSP 屏蔽了注入的热重载脚本，面板侧的兜底仍会刷新它（该兜底在安装/更新后需要刷新一次页面）
- `window.__ModuleLoader__` 与槽位 API 属于 Harness 内部契约，Harness 大版本升级后可能需要小改

dsh-live-preview README · 开发：```powershell
git clone https://github.com/2011126630z-commits/dsh-live-preview
cd dsh-live-preview
npm test        # node:test：鉴权、路径穿越、MIME、注入（含语法检查）、SSE、端口退让、清理
```
